title: Initial registration for initiating an emergency PDU session not accepted by the network

entities.name: Initial registration for emergency services
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attempt initial registration specifically for emergency services when initial registration for emergency PDU session is not accepted by the network.

entities.name: 5GS registration type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of registration being requested, set to 'initial registration' for emergency PDU session initiation.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to establish a PDU session, with request type set to 'initial emergency request' for emergency services.

entities.name: UE in same selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE remains in the same selected PLMN where the last initial registration request was attempted.

entities.name: UE in same selected or equivalent PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE remains in the same selected PLMN or equivalent PLMN where the last initial registration request was attempted.

entities.name: PDU session needed for handover of emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where PDU session needs to be established due to handover of an existing PDN connection for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of procedure failure
entities.description: UE behavior to inform upper layers about the failure of the registration procedure, which may trigger alternative emergency call mechanisms.

entities.name: Procedures in subclause 5.5.1.2.5
entities.description: Reference procedures that UE shall perform when initial registration for emergency PDU session is not accepted by the network.

entities.name: Actions in subclause 5.5.1.2.7
entities.description: Reference actions that UE shall perform when initial registration fails due to abnormal cases.

relations.description: Initial registration for emergency services includes the 5GS registration type IE set to 'initial registration'.
Initial registration for emergency services involves sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message with initial emergency request.
Attempting initial registration for emergency services requires UE to be in same selected PLMN condition.
Attempting initial registration for emergency services requires UE to be in same selected or equivalent PLMN condition.
Condition of PDU session needed for handover of emergency bearer services establishes requirement to attempt initial registration for emergency services.
Condition of UE in same selected PLMN establishes the property of informing upper layers of procedure failure.
Procedures in subclause 5.5.1.2.5 are performed as a step when initial registration for emergency PDU session is not accepted.
Actions in subclause 5.5.1.2.7 include informing upper layers of failure to access network.
